title: DG5 - Translation
claim: A capability may translate between registers or frameworks only if the relevant dependency, constraint, collapse, and role structure is preserved.
assumptions: Different vocabulary can preserve the same structure, but vocabulary resemblance alone is not enough.
definitions: TranslatesTo(C1, C2): C1 is carried into another register as C2 while preserving relevant structure.
bridges: Bridge claims must preserve structure rather than merely compare words.
negative_guards: Do not call vocabulary resemblance an isomorphism.
Do not upgrade analogy to proof.
kill_conditions: A claimed translation preserves vocabulary but not dependency, role, failure mode, or constraint.
The project cannot state what structure must survive translation.

ledger.meaning: Source claim ingested into Lane 4 ledger.
